title: About Milky Bag Underprint
short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 80 recent saved-signal files and 72 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around Anchor image material 1 and Bags | Tensor, plus 7 more. A source image from pbs.twimg.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became Milky Bag Underprint: Square poster crop, side-lit object slab: a central milky translucent bag-like form floats on mottled moss-olive ground, two handle prongs entering the upper band. Three huge saturated red horizontal underprint bands cross behind and through the plastic, entirely illegible. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against central translucent plastic bag slab, upper distressed red underprint band, and lower buried red poster band under plastic.
